programme.title: MisterWives: The Don’t Look Down Tour: Live from The Wiltern
programme.desc: Indie-pop band MisterWives close out The Don’t Look Down Tour with an electrifying, sold-out performance at The Wiltern in Los Angeles. Fronted by Mandy Lee, the group performs a dynamic mix of hits and new songs from their album Nosebleeds, blending soaring vocals, raw emotion, and vibrant stage energy. The night captures the band’s message of resilience, growth, and celebration as they connect with fans in a transformative live experience.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Third Eye Blind frontman Stephan Jenkins joins Joel Madden to discuss songwriting, creativity, and the band’s upcoming album. Jenkins opens up about perfectionism, the struggle to finish lyrics, and the human element that drives his music. He also shares insights on producing, the influence of Eric Valentine, and gearing up for The Summer Gods Tour with Yellowcard and A R I Z O N A.

programme.title: Jimmy Eat World: 20th Anniversary of “Futures” Live From Phoenix
programme.desc: Jimmy Eat World return to their hometown for a one-night celebration of the 20th anniversary of Futures, performing the album front to back at The Van Buren in Phoenix, Arizona. Featuring fan-favorite tracks (“Futures,” “Just Tonight…,” “Work,” “The World You Love,” “Pain,” “Drugs or Me”) and special hometown moments from the band.

programme.title: James Taylor: Live at the Beacon Theatre
programme.desc: James Taylor performs live at the Beacon Theatre, delivering songs from Hourglass alongside classics in a special concert featuring unseen footage.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Joel Madden sits down with Daryl Palumbo of Glassjaw and Head Automatica. Daryl reflects on three decades of genre-defying music, the freedom he’s always pursued as an artist, the self-doubt and restlessness that shaped his work, and how fatherhood became the most grounding and fulfilling experience of his life.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award-winning singer-songwriter Joss Stone joins Joel Madden for a candid conversation about growing up in the music industry, her love of horror movies, and the process of creating a live album.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Sleep Theory frontman Cullen Moore joins Joel Madden to talk about his journey from serving in the U.S. Army to fronting one of modern rock’s fastest-rising bands. Moore reflects on his Memphis roots, discovering his sound, and how TikTok helped launch Sleep Theory to viral success. The two explore discipline, creativity, and how music became Moore’s true “Plan A.”

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Grammy Award–winning country singer-songwriter Lainey Wilson joins Joel Madden to talk about growing up in rural Louisiana, chasing her Nashville dreams, and building a career through perseverance and purpose. They discuss her new album Whirlwind, the balance between ambition and well-being, and the lessons that come from hardship, therapy, and self-discovery.

programme.title: Backstreet Boys: Homecoming - Live In Orlando
programme.desc: Backstreet Boys returns to Orlando for a 1999 homecoming concert, performing hits like As Long As You Love Me and Everybody (Backstreet’s Back).

programme.title: Holding Back the Years: 40 Years of Simply Red, Live in Santiago
programme.desc: Simply Red performs a 40th anniversary concert in Santiago, delivering career-spanning hits from sold-out shows on their global tour.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: Lizzo shows up fully in everything she does, tracing her journey from a diamond record to a fall tour.

programme.title: Artist Friendly
programme.desc: On this week's episode of Artist Friendly, Joel Madden sits down with Paul Walter Hauser. From waiting tables to a Golden Globe, Emmy, and Critics' Choice Award for Black Bird — Paul Walter Hauser has built one of Hollywood's most distinctive careers by refusing to play it safe. Now starring in Fantastic Four and the new Resident Evil, he gets honest about fear, learning to say no, and why being his realest self matters more than chasing the next big role.

programme.title: Rock Concert Cuts
programme.desc: Concert Cuts is an nonstop live rock, featuring electrifying performances from concerts around the world. From iconic anthems to deep cuts, every episode delivers a fresh mix of artists and songs that are coming to you live, loud, and on stage.

programme.title: Subhah Agarwal: Airport Pigeon
programme.desc: Subhah Agarwal delivers a deeply personal stand-up special on mental health, blending sharp humor with stories on rock bottom moments, resilience, and unexpected perspectives.

programme.title: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses: Live From Los Angeles
programme.desc: Iron & Wine and Band of Horses perform a co-headlining concert live from The Wiltern in Los Angeles.
